_doc: Edit decision list. Timeline frames at 30fps (750 total). Source `in` = seconds into the CFR proxy/full clip (same timing as captures/raw). Beat grid assumes 120 BPM (15f/beat) until audio/beats.json replaces it. `segments` = multiple sub-clips played back-to-back inside one shot. `freeze` = hold that source time as a still. v2 (2026-10-18): montage slowed to one beat (15f) per feature after user feedback; film is 795f = 26.5s.

shots.name: hook
caption: Your anime.
All of it.
shots.note: static 1.0–7.8s; camera move carries the shot

shots.name: watching
caption: Track every episode.
shots.note: Ep 6→7 lands at +15f (beat 6), Ep 7→8 at +60f (beat 9). Tap latency made the raw gap 3.6s, hence two segments.

shots.name: calendar
caption: Never miss a drop.
shots.note: countdown badges visible throughout; stepped scroll 1.8–3.0s

shots.name: lists
caption: Rank it. Share it.
shots.note: lift at 2.48 (+8f), drag 3.43–4.15, settle ~4.6; trim first 0.5s banner already excluded

shots.name: profile
caption: Level up your watchlist.
shots.crop: top 55% only — hide the Premium card (claims unimplemented features)

shots.name: dice
caption: Can't decide? Roll.
shots.note: rolling 3.0–5.0, result card fades/pops 5.0–5.5 (+60f = frame 465, beat 31)

shots.name: montage
caption: And so much more.
shots.note: one beat per feature; chips stay on the phone's far side (never over caption/tag); c07c_recs dropped (app bug)

shots.name: payoff
caption: Your whole dex.
In your pocket.
shots.note: raw scroll is stepped (~4fps) → freeze the pre-scroll frame and let the camera pull back

shots.name: end
shots.note: last 15f fade to #0F0F0F + yellow glow = S01 frame 0 for the loop
